tracking.title: Set up Posti tracking codes
tracking.description: Posti tracking needs no account — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `posti.track_parcel` service.

account.title: Set up OmaPosti account
account.description: Sign in once to import parcels from your OmaPosti account. Your password is never stored.

reauth_confirm.title: OmaPosti sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: Posti no longer accepts the stored tokens for {username}. Enter that account's password again.

error.invalid_auth: Unable to sign in with these credentials. Sign-in may not work for an account with two-step verification turned on.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the OmaPosti account service.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: That sign-in is for a different OmaPosti account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a Posti tracking code.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Posti tracking code.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Posti tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Posti tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
